name: Lottie animation
description: Plays After Effects animations exported as Lottie JSON with the Lottie package, with a Reduce Motion fallback and a bundled sample animation.

cost.note: Open-source package (Apache 2.0); designing animations may need paid tools

usage: Add the animation JSON next to the template (or anywhere in the app target) and show it with `LoopingLottie(name: "pulse")`. Pass `loop: false` for one-shot animations. Under Reduce Motion the first frame is shown still. Prefer SwiftUI animations for simple motion; use Lottie when a designer supplies an exported animation.
statusNote: Not yet built on a Mac; run `ios-agent-mcp capabilities verify lottie-animation` on a Mac with Xcode.
